correctness.rationale: Aranda's homogeneous two-point-class matching age justifies the combinatorial diagram classification. For each finite base, j distinct singleton mates contribute (1+z)^s, while the k new one/two element R-fibres contribute (z+z²/2)^k/k! and have independent two-way matchings to m old classes and among themselves, producing exactly 2^{mk+binom(k,2)}. This coefficient-wise proof establishes all arities. The factorial coefficient formula follows from partitions into pairs and singletons. Disjoint intervals [2^m,2^m+m] prove unary recovery. Independent direct-diagram verification checked 40 configurations and Fraction EGF expansion 288 configurations; finite checks are not substituted for the general proof.
